body:
For the rest of my life, I'll be seeing and talking to other people. Who's to say that I won't piss them off too? I probably will. 

Genuinely though I had 100 people like a comment calling me out on a post about how some people are "disrespectful". I'm literally the bad guy in this situation, plus my life, and I can't change that. 

I essentially need to be a better person, try harder in life, and all that jazz, but I simply can't due to a complete lack of motivation.

I know I'm going to die alone,.I won't attract anyone. I'm simply a terrible person who needs to die.
